passage.label: When comes Deafening Blast; Day man flee brother; mother father; wife children; every man Day matter adequate him

arabicExcerpts.text: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ

mainSubject.label: When the Deafening Blast arrives, man will flee from brother, mother, father, wife and children; every person on that Day will have a matter sufficient to occupy him entirely

subordinateSubjects.label: On that Day a man will flee from his brother
And from his mother and his father
And from his wife and his children
Every person that Day having a matter adequate to occupy him

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Deafening Blast triggering total preoccupation overriding all familial bonds
Flight from brother, parents, spouse and children on the Day of reckoning

relationships.label: Each person's own matter becoming adequate to fully occupy him on that Day

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the angelic-carrier description (16) before the human-ingratitude and creation argument opens (17); P2 ends with the agricultural-provision catalogue (32) before the Deafening Blast scene begins (33); P3 covers the five-verse familial-flight sequence (33-37); P4 runs through the bright-versus-darkened faces dichotomy (38-42).
